subject.title: Feature: Cross-platform multi-select component in message tool

question: Should the shared MessagePresentation select contract gain portable batch-selection semantics, and which channels and fallback guarantees must the first version support?
rationale: The change affects a public plugin SDK contract and requires policy choices for scalar compatibility, array callback encoding, unsupported-channel behavior, and whether Telegram hosted UI belongs in the initial scope.

options.title: Add portable batch select
options.body: Extend the existing select block additively, preserve scalar behavior by default, and launch with explicit Discord/Slack support plus deterministic fallback.

options.title: Keep provider-specific forms
options.body: Leave the shared select scalar and expose richer collection only through channel-owned plugin APIs such as Slack modals or Telegram web apps.

options.title: Decline the capability
options.body: Keep text replies and repeated callbacks as the supported cross-platform workflow and close the feature request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Add portable batch select
recommendation.body: Extend the existing select block additively, preserve scalar behavior by default, and launch with explicit Discord/Slack support plus deterministic fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is connected to the current presentation contract and has already routed the issue as a maintainer product decision.
